top.line: Odoo's agents can write to the system of record; our stack fits around every Odoo, from 12 to 20.
top.para: An ephemeral proof of concept went from nothing to customised in under a minute on four versions.

in-short.line: Odoo agents write; policies, an Odoo cell, vaults and keys; every version; use the future now.

why.line: Odoo 20 agents create and update records from automated and scheduled actions, with a native MCP server.
why.para: Agents now execute in many small companies' system of record.

gap.line: Power comes from tools and the user behind them; approvals are per agent; conversations last 30 days.
gap.para: The gap every agent platform has.

abp.line: A behaviour policy per Odoo agent: grant, mandate, gap and barrier; Odoo's access rights are the boundary.
abp.para: An Odoo module could measure the grant automatically.

cell.line: An Odoo cell on AgentiCCells' ladder, from one workflow at £500 to a network at £20,000.
cell.para: The factory can make sites that read from Odoo.

apply.line: Agents plan in a vault, a person signs, a broker applies through the API, and the record lasts.

more.line: SHarness around the Odoo server, VoiceDebrief into the CRM, PrompTugal.news with local businesses.

versions.line: Every Odoo since 12 has an API: XML-RPC, keys from 14, JSON-2 from 19, MCP from 20.
versions.para: An old Odoo full of real data is the better data source.

poc.line: Odoo 19, 18, 15 and 12, each from nothing to customised in under a minute, then removed.
poc.para: The same agent on all four; only its calls adapt.

future.line: Customers need not wait for the upgrade: we bring agents and policies to what they run now.
future.para: And use Odoo's own agents when they arrive.

plan.line: The proof of concept is done; next a copy of a real customer's Odoo, the broker, the offer, partners.

watch.line: Odoo moves fast; plan gates; legacy RPC deprecated, so use what each version has.

limits.line: A strategy and a proof of concept on Community images; Odoo 20 and Enterprise untested.

sources.line: Odoo's release notes, integrators' summaries, Odoo's documentation, and earlier articles.
